method: Silence score, 0 to 100: 40% how big the need is (OCHA FTS requirements), 30% how much of it is unfunded (OCHA FTS), 30% how little the news covers it (GDELT, 7 days). Each part is ranked against every other crisis on the board.

crises.title: Sudan
crises.text: In El Fasher, a city in North Darfur, civilians were cut off from food, water and medical care during a long siege by the Rapid Support Forces. The city fell in late October 2025. The war across Sudan is still going.
